title: Pedestrian Deaths Rose 77%
closing: Roads improved for drivers while becoming deadlier for the people walking beside them.
question: Do your streets feel safe?

segments.say: Traffic deaths fell to 40,990. Overall road safety improved for a second straight year.
Pedestrian deaths rose 77 percent. Their increase far outpaced every other traffic death.
Pedestrian deaths reached 7,508. People on foot now carry a growing share of road danger.
